title: Route Draw
description: A route draws across an abstract map from first signal to final destination, making a journey instantly legible.

defaultProps.title: A clearer way forward.
defaultProps.subtitle: Draw the path from the first step to the moment it matters.

title: Multi Stop
description: A numbered multi-stop itinerary reveals each checkpoint in sequence with clear labels and progress.

defaultProps.title: Five stops. One story.
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a long itinerary into a sequence people can follow.

title: Origin Destination
description: A focused origin-to-destination bridge keeps the start and finish prominent while the route animates between them.

defaultProps.title: From here to there.
defaultProps.subtitle: Show the distance, the direction, and the destination in one beat.

title: Branching Route
description: A central hub branches into multiple routes so options, service areas, and diverging journeys can be compared.

defaultProps.title: Every route starts here.
defaultProps.subtitle: Make choices and service branches visible without losing the main path.

title: Day By Day
description: A day-by-day map itinerary advances one stop at a time with strong day labels and a calm travel rhythm.

defaultProps.title: The long weekend.
defaultProps.subtitle: Give every day a place, a pace, and a memorable next step.

title: Flight Path
description: An arcing flight path connects airports with a moving aircraft marker and bright dashed trajectory.

defaultProps.title: Across the distance.
defaultProps.subtitle: Turn a flight plan into an elegant arc from departure to arrival.

title: Delivery Route
description: A delivery route moves from warehouse to doorstep through operational checkpoints and last-mile handoffs.

defaultProps.title: Right to your door.
defaultProps.subtitle: Explain the invisible choreography behind a reliable delivery.

title: Migration Map
description: A long, branching movement map visualizes migration, rollout, adoption, or change across several phases.

defaultProps.title: Where change takes root.
defaultProps.subtitle: Show movement over time as a sequence of connected phases.

title: Walking Tour
description: A friendly walking-tour path reveals neighborhood stops one by one with compact labels and gentle motion.

defaultProps.title: Take the scenic route.
defaultProps.subtitle: Lead viewers through a place with stops worth remembering.

title: Map To Photo
description: A route builds to a highlighted location and can reveal an optional photo card for a map-to-memory transition.

defaultProps.title: A place becomes a memory.
defaultProps.subtitle: Move from the abstract route to the moment waiting at the destination.
